outcome: Active governance and Scene-creation rules are reconciled to the latest accepted rendition without changing live Foundry state or historical evidence.

reconciledConflicts.before: Several active rules named database/seed.sql as the only accepted append surface.
reconciledConflicts.after: Narrow chronological additions default to dated database/seed.d/*.sql deltas; database/build_database.py applies schema.sql, seed.sql, then lexical seed.d and database/verify_database.py verifies integrity.

reconciledConflicts.before: An older hardening document and template still described PREPARE -> RENDER -> INSPECT -> APPROVE -> BUILD.
reconciledConflicts.after: The outer API is PREPARE -> RENDER -> INSPECT(PASS = APPROVED | REDO) -> BUILD; APPROVE is optional and redundant after final PASS.

reconciledConflicts.before: One Definition-of-Ready clause could be read as requiring Google document synchronization before local implementation despite the accepted non-blocking mirror rule.
reconciledConflicts.after: Repository roadmap/current active card plus reproducible KB are immediate authority; scheduled communication mirrors are non-blocking except at explicit publication/coordination boundaries.

reconciledConflicts.before: Older general rules treated map pixels only as renderers and prescribed a blueprint -> empty renderer ordering that conflicted with the newly accepted grayscale semantic-inspection workflow.
reconciledConflicts.after: New Scene Creation uses PREPARE -> grayscale STRUCTURAL_RENDER -> STRUCTURAL_INSPECT -> Feature Manifest/Spatial Blueprint reconciliation -> PAINT_RENDER -> FINAL_INSPECT -> BUILD/projection. Raw pixels never directly become Foundry authority; inspected observations become deterministic only after reconciliation.

reconciledConflicts.before: The camera rule forbade visible vertical faces in language that could conflict with the approved Blender-like structural model.
reconciledConflicts.after: The camera remains strict 90-degree orthographic; depth comes from wall-top thickness, bevels, relief, ambient occlusion, contact shadows, and object-height cues without perspective tilt.

reconciledConflicts.before: The automated Scene workflow listed current conversation context ahead of durable state.
reconciledConflicts.after: Durable state/receipts and repository/campaign records outrank conversation context, which is non-authoritative intent only.

reconciledConflicts.before: The first two-pass draft allowed a structural REDO before paint while the older outer transition list only named PREPARED -> RENDERED.
reconciledConflicts.after: A structural PASS may remain PREPARED while painting completes; a structural failure may use INSPECTED_REDO with the structural render as bound failed-render evidence; RENDERED denotes the painterly candidate.

remainingOpenItem.nextAction: Define the machine-readable Feature Manifest schema, bind structural/final inspection receipts to exact render hashes, map manifest categories into deterministic Scene/Foundry projection plans, and add representative fixtures/tests.

manifestContract: Provisional manifest-entry fields are now documented for stable feature identity, source render identity, geometry primitive/coordinates, movement/vision/sound/light intent, ownership/statefulness, Foundry projection hint, relationships, and uncertainty; machine-readable schema/enforcement remains O-2026-10-07-SCENE-FEATURE-MANIFEST.
